title.narrative: Strengthening Ukraine Ministry of Health (MoH) Accountability Framework to Manage MEDEVAC & Repatriation Systems and Services

description.narrative: Contract related to: Strengthening Ukraine Ministry of Health (MoH) Accountability Framework to Manage MEDEVAC & Repatriation Systems and Services - This 18-monthmeasure seeks to support war affected populations through the provision of conflict-sensitive and more resilient models of access to education and healthto conflict-affected communities. A first component will focus on access to education in areas that are particularly impacted by the Russian war of aggression, including those recently liberated from Russian military control and those hosting a large number of internally displaced persons. Assistance will be given in a flexible manner through local Ukrainian administrations(Hromadas) to tailor specific access-to-education models to local needs. This will include support to bothoffline and online schooling solutions, including for examplerehabilitation or construction of shelters, classrooms and other facilities (e.g. for sports or psychological support and counselling); or the provision of modular school-centres. The hromadas and school administrations will be supported e.g. in crisis management as well as psychological support to their employees and students. A second component will focus on the needs of the Ukrainian health system related to a growing number of Ukrainian patients having received medical support in EU and EEA countries.Support will be provided forthe safe repatriation to Ukraine of patients willing to return, as well as to strengthen the trauma surgery and treatment capacity of the Ukrainian health system, to limit the number of patients requiring evacuationand to accompany the rehabilitation of repatriatedpatients.
